name: Etapp 7: BLT Darreluoppal - STF Såmmarlappa Fjällstuga
description: BLT Darreluoppal to STF Såmmarlappa Fjällstuga. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
utilities: No verified swimming place or outdoor fireplace (service)
waterSources: Natural streams and jokks along Darreluoppal-Såmmarlappa: The stage crosses and follows multiple streams/jokks. STF hut water is fetched from natural sources. Treat all natural water as condition- and treatment-dependent.

facilities.name: BLT Darreluoppal / Tarraluoppal cabins
facilities.coordinateSource: Padjelanta.se official coordinate; OSM node 1896395800 is about 2.6 m away.
facilities.description: BLT cabin camp at the stage start with 36 beds, one year-round open cabin/room, emergency/help phone, limited provisions subject to availability, and Fiskflyg boundary pickup/drop-off context.

facilities.description: Basic provisions/canned food may be sold by hut hosts, but supplies can run out and kiosk purchases are cash-only. Card/prepayment details for accommodation differ by source and should be rechecked.

facilities.description: Safety room/emergency shelter function within the Såmmarlappa hut complex. Import as standalone only if shelter taxonomy supports hut safety rooms; otherwise attach to hut metadata.

facilities.description: Small STF hut shop/provisions at Såmmarlappa. Availability and payment details should be rechecked before relying on it.
